messages:
nina_park: Partner asked for a single "quickstart" repo they can publish to marketplace and fork. Must include Terraform modules, AMI + container build paths, marketplace metadata examples, and a tiny CI smoke run. Keep it copy/paste friendly.

tom_evans: Key constraints from partner: must support arm64 and amd64, include an example of private VPC deployment, and publish listing artifact templates that map to both AWS and GCP marketplaces.

sam_keller: I'll scope terraform/aws and terraform/gcp submodules. Each will expose variables for arch, instance_size, model_version, k8s vs vm install. Will include outputs for LB/DNS and IAM role ARNs.

priya_mehta: I'll draft marketplace examples: short/long descriptions, feature bullets, screenshots placeholders, support contact field, license.md and an export-control note. Legal review needed before we hand to partner.

infra_bot: repo scaffolded: llm-quickstart-packaging. Branch protection and issue templates added.

sam_keller: For images: prefer to provide Packer + Docker Buildx pipelines. Add manifests/manifest.example.yaml with per-region AMI mapping instructions rather than publishing AMIs ourselves. Also include multi-arch container manifest for GHCR registry.

priya_mehta: Add a README section "What to publish" that lists the exact files a partner should upload to marketplace consoles to avoid back-and-forth.

nina_park: Security note from SOC: include KMS snippet, guidance on role-based access for partner accounts, and a short section on audit logging retention defaults. Also flag any pinned model_version guidance for compliance customers.

tom_evans: CI plan: GH Actions matrix builds for amd64/arm64, packer AMI build job that can assume role in partner account, and a smoke workflow that assumes partner role, deploys minimal infra, hits /health and a single /predict call, then destroys. Smoke should be under 7m.

sam_keller: I'll add variables.tf with conservative defaults and an examples/ directory with 2 varfiles: example.arm.tfvars and example.x86.tfvars plus sample quantization notes.

priya_mehta: Timeline: PR with README + marketplace templates + CODEOWNERS by Tue; GH Actions + smoke by Thu; legal sign-off on listing copy by following Mon. Who can lead partner walk-through?

nina_park: I can run the walkthrough and record a short video. Also will prepare a one-pager handoff checklist.

devrel_bot: Task created PART-492: llm-quickstart-packaging initial draft. Due 2026-04-10. Assignees: sam_keller, priya_mehta, nina_park, tom_evans.
